title: Emmett Barry

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: In Cleveland. I've tried to contact him several times and there have been no answer. They say, I don't know, he lost his mind or he's hung up doing something, I just don't know, and I haven't bothered recently because I've tried several times and been unable to reach him, because I just figured he just didn't want to be bothered, you know. And great little trumpet player, he was with Johnny Hodges, little small band, up there he did a great job at CBS, great job.
What kind of a person was he at that time?
Oh just great, just beautiful. Just beautiful.
